name: Outdoor Interiors
old_description: Explore fresh horizons with us as we introduce you to some groundbreaking innovations. Your journey to a more stylish and comfortable year begins here!
about:
Outdoor Interiors was founded in 2006 in Lake Barrington, Illinois, by Tim Cimaglio, who remains president. The company began with the goal of creating a unique product line in the outdoor living space, targeting an underserved niche with quality at mid-tier price points.

The company designs and manufactures outdoor furniture using sustainable, plantation-grown FSC-certified teak and eucalyptus, along with powder-coated aluminum, HDPE all-weather wicker, nautical rope, sling, concrete composite, fabrics, and natural stone. Its collections include fully assembled folding loungers, stacking chairs, table sets, daybeds, and coordinating throw pillows. Operations span over 70,000 square feet of warehouse space and a 5,000-square-foot showroom at Atlanta’s AmericasMart, serving a network of more than 150 dealers and key retail groups across North America.

Outdoor Interiors sells primarily through its nationwide dealer network and retail partners, with showrooms in Lake Barrington available by appointment. Its customers include independent patio and garden retailers, specialty outdoor living stores, and larger retail groups seeking mid-priced, design-forward furniture.

The brand differentiates itself by focusing on sustainable sourcing, innovative storage solutions integrated into its furniture, and a blend of mixed materials that deliver both style and durability at accessible price points.
